Out-of-bag estimation of overall accuracy, per-allele sensitivity, etc

hlaOutOfBag.Rd

Out-of-bag estimation of overall accuracy, per-allele sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value and call rate.

hlaOutOfBag(model, hla, snp, call.threshold=NaN, verbose=TRUE)

Arguments

model

an object of hlaAttrBagClass or hlaAttrBagObj

hla

the training HLA types, an object of hlaAlleleClass

snp

the training SNP genotypes, an object of hlaSNPGenoClass

call.threshold

the specified call threshold; if NaN, no threshold is used

verbose

if TRUE, show information

Value

Return hlaAlleleClass.

Author

Xiuwen Zheng

See also

hlaCompareAllele, hlaReport

Examples

# load HLA types and SNP genotypes
data(HLA_Type_Table, package="HIBAG")
data(HapMap_CEU_Geno, package="HIBAG")

# make a "hlaAlleleClass" object
hla.id <- "A"
hla <- hlaAllele(HLA_Type_Table$sample.id,
  H1 = HLA_Type_Table[, paste(hla.id, ".1", sep="")],
  H2 = HLA_Type_Table[, paste(hla.id, ".2", sep="")],
  locus=hla.id, assembly="hg19")

# SNP predictors within the flanking region on each side
region <- 500   # kb
snpid <- hlaFlankingSNP(HapMap_CEU_Geno$snp.id, HapMap_CEU_Geno$snp.position,
  hla.id, region*1000, assembly="hg19")
length(snpid)  # 275
#> [1] 275

# training and validation genotypes
geno <- hlaGenoSubset(HapMap_CEU_Geno,
  snp.sel = match(snpid, HapMap_CEU_Geno$snp.id),
  samp.sel = match(hla$value$sample.id, HapMap_CEU_Geno$sample.id))

# train a HIBAG model
set.seed(100)
# please use "nclassifier=100" when you use HIBAG for real data
model <- hlaAttrBagging(hla, geno, nclassifier=4)
#> 9 monomorphic SNPs have been removed.
#> Build a PONG2 model with 4 individual classifiers:
#> # of SNPs randomly sampled as candidates for each selection: 17
#> # of SNPs: 266, # of samples: 60
#> # of unique KIR3DL1/S1 alleles: 14
#> Tue May 19 19:47:29 2026,   1 individual classifier, out-of-bag acc: 93.75%, # of SNPs: 15, # of haplo: 54
#> Tue May 19 19:47:29 2026,   2 individual classifier, out-of-bag acc: 94.44%, # of SNPs: 18, # of haplo: 34
#> Tue May 19 19:47:29 2026,   3 individual classifier, out-of-bag acc: 91.30%, # of SNPs: 14, # of haplo: 38
#> Tue May 19 19:47:29 2026,   4 individual classifier, out-of-bag acc: 97.37%, # of SNPs: 18, # of haplo: 64
summary(model)
#> Gene: HLA - A
#> Training dataset: 60 samples X 266 SNPs
#> 	# of KIR3DL1/S1 alleles: 14
#> 	# of individual classifiers: 4
#> 	total # of SNPs used: 54
#> 	average # of SNPs in an individual classifier: 16.25, sd: 2.06, min: 14, max: 18
#> 	average # of haplotypes in an individual classifier: 47.50, sd: 13.99, min: 34, max: 64
#> 	average out-of-bag accuracy: 94.22%, sd: 2.50%, min: 91.30%, max: 97.37%
#> Genome assembly: hg19

# out-of-bag estimation
(comp <- hlaOutOfBag(model, hla, geno, call.threshold=NaN, verbose=TRUE))
#> Gene: HLA - A
#> Training dataset: 60 samples X 266 SNPs
#> 	# of KIR3DL1/S1 alleles: 14
#> 	# of individual classifiers: 4
#> 	total # of SNPs used: 54
#> 	average # of SNPs in an individual classifier: 16.25, sd: 2.06, min: 14, max: 18
#> 	average # of haplotypes in an individual classifier: 47.50, sd: 13.99, min: 34, max: 64
#> 	average out-of-bag accuracy: 94.22%, sd: 2.50%, min: 91.30%, max: 97.37%
#> Genome assembly: hg19
#> Error in hlaPredict(object, snp, cl, type, vote, allele.check, match.type,     same.strand, verbose, verbose.match): The handle of HIBAG model has been closed.

# report
hlaReport(comp, type="txt")
#> Allele	Num.	Freq.	Num.	Freq.	CR	ACC	SEN	SPE	PPV	NPV	Miscall
#> 	Train	Train	Valid.	Valid.	(%)	(%)	(%)	(%)	(%)	(%)	(%)
#> ----
#> Overall accuracy: 84.8%, Call rate: 95.1%
#> KIR2DS5*0000	568	0.8304	372	0.8267	96.2	84.8	98.0	17.1	85.8	82.9	KIR2DS5*00201 (86)
#> KIR2DS5*00201	106	0.1550	70	0.1556	91.4	85.7	14.1	98.4	60.0	87.4	KIR2DS5*0000 (100)
#> KIR2DS5*00701	5	0.0073	3	0.0067	100.0	99.8	100.0	99.8	75.0	100.0	--
#> KIR2DS5*009	5	0.0073	5	0.0111	60.0	99.3	0.0	100.0	--	99.3	KIR2DS5*0000 (100)
